summary: Frontend end-to-end testing of iter49 Announcements/Notice Board and Offboarding workflows on preview. All 8 user-story test cases pass. Announcements CRUD + urgent banner + dashboard notice card + dismiss + role gating + 403 restriction all functional. Offboarding start/role-gated completion (HR→Payroll→Admin)/auto-deactivation and HR cancel flow all functional. Backend push notifications may be skipped (VAPID) — not treated as failure per spec.

integration_issues.flow: Employees → Add employee (pre-existing, outside iter49 scope)
integration_issues.issue: Form silently swallows backend 422 validation errors — no toast or inline message when email domain is rejected (e.g. '.test' TLD reserved by pydantic email validator) or employment_type is wrong case. Modal stays open with form data intact and user has no feedback. Not blocking iter49 but worth flagging.

action_items: (Optional, pre-existing) Surface 422 errors from POST /api/employees in the Add employee modal via toast/inline messages so users know why save failed.
critical_code_review_comments: AnnouncementsCard, UrgentAnnouncementBanner, Announcements page and OffboardingPanel are all clean, small, well-structured components with correct data-testid coverage.

OffboardingPanel.mayComplete correctly enforces role gating: role===item.responsible_role, with admin override; the UI matches the backend role check (verified HR, Payroll, Admin each only see their respective Mark complete buttons).
Urgent banner dismiss persists via sessionStorage key shcm_dismissed_announcements as spec'd.

seed_data_creation: Created 2 throwaway employees via POST /api/employees (QATestA/B Throw1792432373 @salonehcm.sl). Both DELETED after test (200 OK). Created 1 TEST urgent announcement, deleted after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter49 feature set (announcements + offboarding) is production-ready. Note: creating an employee without an associated user login means the 'login returns 401 Account deactivated' can't be directly verified from the UI alone; backend test_iter49_announcements_offboarding.py covers that path. To create throwaway employees via API, use employment_type='Full-time' (exact case) and a non-reserved email TLD (.sl, .com — not .test).
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs in iter49 scope. The only observed issue (silent 422 on employee create modal) is a pre-existing UX gap not introduced by this iteration.
